title: CT scan of the implant arranged by an unnamed insider

tellings.quote: Anyway, he wants me to get a CT scan of the implant.

plain: The writer Whitley Strieber, who says he has been visited by non-human beings, says an unnamed insider wanted him to have a CT scan of an implant in his body, and arranged it in California. Strieber tells Michels this first-hand ("he wants me to get a CT scan of the implant"), as a sign that people inside the system took the object seriously.
